environmentStop.stopReason: WEC-2 requires at least 4096 MiB free before npm ci. The observed 237904 KiB is below that threshold, and no disposable node_modules, .next, private, coverage, dist, build, or /tmp/legalease-npm-cache directory was available for cleanup. The mandatory npm ci, corpus bootstrap, source environment, and packet-build preflight sequence therefore could not start.
environmentStop.whyRemainingRowsAreUnsafeOrMeaningless: Every assigned proof obligation depends on an independently established packet-build environment and source corpus. Reading builder-authored reports as substitutes would not independently verify artifact bytes, geometry, writes, route identity, or source custody. No source is asserted missing or mismatched; the source environment was never recovered.
environmentStop.reopenCondition: Provide at least 4194304 KiB free, then run npm ci, bootstrap the private corpus, source private/source-corpus-environment.txt, export MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR, and obtain PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_READY before evaluating any row.
